title: Card Payments Counted Against the Portal Credit-Card Ceiling (Placed Consumer Accounts)
content:
Payments risk memorandum clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the card payments counted against the portal credit-card ceiling of the day.

## Clause

The card payments counted against the portal credit-card ceiling are:
- **every card payment, debit or credit, received in the last two months**, where one or more returned payments were received on the account in the last six months and a debit-card payment was received on the handling date;
- **the card payments, debit or credit, received on the handling date**, where no returned payment was received in the last six months and a debit-card payment was received on the handling date;
- **the credit-card payments received in the last month**, in every other case.

The card payments counted are subtracted, at their total, in working out the portal credit-card ceiling.

## Terms used

- *Returned payments*: returned-payment entries on the account's money history, of any channel or reason, dated when the return was received.
- *Card payments*: consumer payments posted on the account's money history through the debit-card or credit-card channel.
- *Last N months*: a payment or return falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month. On a handling date of 2026-10-10 the last month starts on 2026-09-11, the last two months on 2026-08-11 and the last six months on 2026-04-11.
- *Received on the handling date*: dated the handling date itself.

## Decision table

| Returned payment in the last six months | Debit-card payment received on the handling date | Card payments counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Debit-card and credit-card payments of the last two months |
| No | Yes | Debit-card and credit-card payments of the handling date |
| Yes | No | Credit-card payments of the last month |
| No | No | Credit-card payments of the last month |

## Hypothetical worked case

*Invented history, handling date 2026-10-10:* credit-card payment $300.00 on 2026-08-20; credit-card payment $200.00 on 2026-09-30; debit-card payment $500.00 on 2026-10-10.

| Return history | Row | Total counted |
|---|---|---|
| A payment returned on 2026-07-02 | First | $300.00 plus $200.00 plus $500.00, that is $1000.00 |
| No return in the last six months | Second | $500.00 (only the handling date's card payments) |
| A return on 2026-07-02, but no debit-card payment on the handling date | Third | $200.00 |
